source.title: A Primary Care Guide to the Screening and Pharmacologic Management of Chronic Kidney Disease in People Living With Type 2 Diabetes

review_status_policy: All language-model extracted atoms remain needs_review; no human verification was inferred.
schema_gaps: The current atom model is primary-literature oriented and lacks a dedicated review_recommendation or guideline_recommendation atom kind. Review recommendations are stored as author_conclusion or other with descriptive tags.
Descriptive epidemiologic percentages without an exposure cannot satisfy quantitative_result sufficiency requirements. They are retained as other and tagged secondary_reported_result.
Secondary trial results are anchored to this review and tagged secondary_reported_result. They must not be interpreted as primary-study atoms.
source_integrity_flags: Figure 1 uses mg/mmol around a sentence that prints a UACR threshold as 20 mg/mol.
Finerenone dose prose overlaps at eGFR 60 mL/min/1.73 m2, whereas Figure 5 separates the 10 mg range as >25 to <60 and the 20 mg range as >=60.

Figure 5 displays an albuminuria >=200 mg/g criterion alongside eGFR >=20 for the SGLT2 inhibitor branch, while nearby prose recommends SGLT2 inhibitor treatment at eGFR >=20 without that albuminuria requirement.
